tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create a short link that redirects to a URL. Returns shortUrl, which is what you share.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the active (not expired) links of the account with their click counts.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Details of one link: destination, clicks, creation and expiry dates, last click and recent click history.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Change where a link points, set a new expiry (Pro) or remove its expiry. The short code stays the same.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a link permanently. Anyone opening it afterwards gets "not found". Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Click analytics for the whole account: totals, bots, daily series and top links. The plan caps how far back you can look (Free 30 days, Pro 365).
